messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.8%, not the 4.45% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.68 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.60 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.62 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We are willing to extend the agreement to 24 months as proposed in your Option B, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage the material risk over this longer period. On this basis, we can offer a revised price of €5.70 per unit.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.70 per unit, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We maintain our offer of €5.70 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days payment terms and an AS-14404 index clause.
Regarding your question, we consider a base month of 2026-08 and a 0% deadband to be fair and standard for such agreements.
You state that the data does not support our price; please share the specific figures you are basing this on so we can review them.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH,

Thank you for your reply - we are disappointed that your price has hardly moved.

As it stands the offer is not acceptable to us; the options below show where we need to get to. We keep our offer as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.54 per unit, 24-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 5.54 per unit, 36-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.

We hope you can take a real step so that we can close this together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your message and your continued interest in our range of steel products. We have carefully considered your request for a further price reduction, but without new supporting data, we cannot adjust our calculation.

Therefore, we must maintain our offer of €5.70 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days payment terms and an AS-14404 index clause. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

To summarise our current Angebot, it comprises a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We are confident that this package represents a fair and sustainable basis for our continued partnership, and we would be delighted to keep serving you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
